taxonomy_basis: Clock-gating interface and glitch-free transition obligations; drafted from the frozen RTL root and saved tests, so independent review remains required

scenarios.name: disabled-to-enabled clock transition
scenarios.spec_citation: Clock-gating contract: enabling the gate admits the first complete clock pulse without a runt pulse

scenarios.name: enabled-to-disabled clock transition
scenarios.spec_citation: Clock-gating contract: disabling the gate completes the active pulse and then blocks subsequent pulses

scenarios.name: clock enable and test mode switch
scenarios.spec_citation: Clock-gating contract: clock_en and test_mode changes preserve deterministic full-pulse output behavior

scenarios.name: rapid control toggle robustness
scenarios.spec_citation: Glitch-free clock-gating contract: rapid control changes must not create pulses narrower than the input clock pulse

line_coverage_targets.name: shared instrumented clock-gate RTL scope
line_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: At least one LCOV hit on every one of the eight shared instrumented lines in e203_clkgate.v

functional_coverage_targets.name: clock blocked while disabled
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Observe complete input clock cycles while both enables are inactive
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample clk_in and clk_out at both phases for at least two complete cycles
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: clk_out remains inactive for the complete observation window
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: saved records do not provide a common per-model semantic sampling trace

functional_coverage_targets.name: functional enable propagation
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Enable clock_en from a disabled state and observe propagated full pulses
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample the control transition and both phases of the first two admitted pulses
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: clk_out follows clk_in without an incomplete first pulse
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: saved records do not provide a common per-model semantic sampling trace

functional_coverage_targets.name: test mode enable propagation
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Enable test_mode with clock_en inactive and observe propagated full pulses
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Sample the mode transition and both phases of the first two admitted pulses
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: test_mode admits clk_in without a runt or missing pulse
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: saved records do not provide a common per-model semantic sampling trace

functional_coverage_targets.name: glitch-free control transitions
functional_coverage_targets.coverage_definition: Toggle clock_en and test_mode at low- and high-phase boundaries
functional_coverage_targets.sampling_rule: Measure every clk_out high and low interval across the frozen transition matrix
functional_coverage_targets.oracle_definition: Every output pulse is either fully blocked or has the complete input-clock pulse width
functional_coverage_targets.unavailable_reason: saved records do not provide a common per-model semantic sampling trace
